allowed_dispositions_considered.why: The successor carries all seven accepted source plans and encodes every SRC27 correction correctly. What remains is exactly two named classes of pendency: runtime acceptance of the session/plan mechanisms (TAC-01..TAC-07, all candidate maxima) and source-dependent values that cannot be fixed source-free (the byte ceilings). Both are recorded as typed, issuance-blocking pendings rather than as structural gaps.

allowed_dispositions_considered.rejected_because: Would assert a structural gap in the instrument. There is none: all seven plans bind completely, expected/floor/maximum/observed are distinct on every account, the outer route-pass account is separate, and 20 asserted invariants pass. The one genuine structural gap found - that full_route_passes has NO owner in the session/broker account model - is a gap in the RUNTIME, not in this instrument, and it is carried as TAC-05.

No conflict exists between governing artifacts. The independent review's stronger claim - that one Route-B pass freezes exactly one full reader invocation and exactly one decoder entry - was already corrected by HQ200 adjudication, and this successor follows the correction rather than encoding the rejected reading.

True of the byte ceilings alone, but it would characterise the whole instrument as incomplete when the byte requirement is one accounted family among many and is fully and correctly typed as UNBOUND_SOURCE_DEPENDENT__MUST_BE_BOUND_BEFORE_LAUNCH. The selected disposition names the pendency precisely instead.
